title: Retry after payment timeout does not duplicate order
expected: First call 504 PAYMENT_TIMEOUT with no order; retry gives exactly one order; third call returns the same order (200)
actual: ✔ first call returned 504 PAYMENT_TIMEOUT after 5014 ms; ✔ no order after the timeout; ✔ stock released (5); ✔ retry returned 201; ✔ third call returned 200, same order true; ✔ exactly 1 order in history; ✔ stock reduced once (4); ✔ database holds 1 order(s) for this customer
